title: PKI Certificate Role Request
description: Schema for Vault PKI certificate role request YAML files under namespace-tn001/requests/certificates/.

allowed_domains.description: List of domains for which certificates can be requested.

allow_bare_domains.description: Allow certificates matching the exact allowed_domains entries.

allow_subdomains.description: Allow certificates for subdomains of allowed_domains.

allowed_serial_numbers.description: Allowed serial numbers to put in Subject.

ttl.description: Default TTL in seconds for issued certificates (e.g. 86400).

max_ttl.description: Maximum TTL in seconds for issued certificates (e.g. 604800).

key_bits.description: Number of bits for the generated key.

signature_bits.description: Number of bits to use in the signature algorithm.

key_usage.description: Allowed key usage constraints on issued certificates.

ext_key_usage.description: Allowed extended key usage constraints on issued certificates.

ext_key_usage_oids.description: Allowed extended key usage OIDs on issued certificates.

cn_validations.description: Validations to run on the CN field.

use_csr_common_name.description: Use the CN in the CSR.

use_csr_sans.description: Use the SANs in the CSR.

generate_lease.description: Generate a Vault lease for issued certificates.

no_store.description: Do not store certificates in the Vault storage backend.

issuer_ref.description: Reference to the named issuer. Defaults to 'default'.
